title: Note Plugin Migration To Crate And Taxonomy Consolidation
description: Migrate the 🗒️note plugin from its old 8-crate constitutional layout (manifest/artifact, app facade, and 6 module crates: engine/dsl/op/pack/protocol/ui) to the new single-crate taxonomy layout at ✏️s/🔌️plugins/🗒️note/📦️packages/🦀️rust, following the proven recipe in CRATE-CONSOLIDATION-AND-PLUGIN-TAXONOMY-RESTRUCTURE/📋️TEMPLATE.md. Includes: package scaffolding, lib.rs with taxonomy #[path] wiring, Cargo.toml union with workspace=true adoption, code migration per TEMPLATE §4 mapping table, Command decomposition via app_commands!, manifest stitch, per-node tests + wire-format guards, wire-baseline capture/diff proof, and deletion of the 8 old crates once the new crate is green. Ends with a registrar handoff block (no self-application of registrar changes). Strictly scoped to ✏️s/🔌️plugins/🗒️note/** — no edits to root Cargo.toml, other plugins, or registry scripts.
